tweets.name: Dina Ravioli
tweets.text: Kevin leads Ryan 137.6-100.3 with games still live and the second seed is now a full conversation. Corbishley is losing to Wingard. If both hold, the playoff picture at 2-through-7 gets reshuffled in a single Tuesday night.

tweets.name: Vance Hollis
tweets.text: DREW IS AT 52.8. MITCHUM IS AT 122.2. ATLAS HAS BEEN OUTSCORED BY SEVENTY POINTS AND THE WEEK IS NOT OVER. THE CHEAPEST LISTING IN EXCHANGE HISTORY IS PLAYING LIKE IT.

tweets.name: Big Dog
tweets.text: Charles is currently LOSING to Jake, 176.4-180.5. I went back and checked Matteo's rankings — Jake is ninth. Charles is first. The scoreboard does not care about Matteo's rankings and neither does the scoreboard.

tweets.name: Matteo Honeydew
tweets.text: Jake is beating Charles live right now and I want you to notice he is doing it at 8-10 with the worst tight end room in the league by two independent grades. That is not a power ranking correction. That is one week. Come find me when it is a trend.

tweets.name: Jay Kelpey
tweets.text: Buddy, I went 1-1 on locks last week and I am 8-4 on the season, tied for the top of the board — and the entire punditry class is watching Adam lead Fronge while Corbishley bleeds to Wingard. Some weeks the game breaks your model and some weeks it breaks Corbishley's running backs.

tweets.name: Bo Ruckman
tweets.text: 8-4, two locks correct, and I want a segment specifically on Kevin at 13-5 — because if he closes out Ryan tonight he has the head-to-head tiebreaker in a race where Corbishley is currently losing. The fragile 13-5 that Matteo flagged is about to have company.

tweets.name: Terrence E. Odom
tweets.text: 5-7 on the year and I had Wingard over Corbishley — and right now Wingard is still leading. Locks record is 1-1. I am not asking for respect. I am asking you to watch the scoreboard.

tweets.name: Dexter Vail
tweets.text: I called the Shaq RB situation a structural problem three issues ago and tonight he is beating Brent 107.0-76.5 without a running back worth rostering. I will not explain how that is happening. I will simply note that I was right about the problem and the problem is still there.

tweets.name: Vivienne Ashcroft
tweets.text: Fronge relocated to Havana for regulatory flexibility, added two waivers and a tight end out of Dallas this week, and is currently losing to Adam's 4-14 squad by 25 points. The Ledger is going to need a full section just for ForgeHammer's Week 10 audit.

tweets.name: Clara Hopkins
tweets.text: APEX at $125.49, down 8.1% last issue, losing to a $59.14 stock tonight — and the Week 10 Ledger has not even opened yet. The exchange is going to have opinions about this by Thursday.
